name: Pinky Ghuman
tagline: Top rated Employment & Labor attorney in Pasadena, California
side_practice_areas: Employment & Labor, Constitutional Law, Alternative Dispute Resolution
about: Pinky Ghuman is the founder and owner of the Ghuman Law Firm in Pasadena, California, and she provides legal services to clients all across California. Her practice areas include constitutional law, business litigation and alternative dispute resolution. She also handles employment law involving employees, mediation, wage and hour laws, noncompete agreements, sexual harassment, trade secret and whistleblower cases.

An academic scholar, Ms. Ghuman graduated with a Bachelor of Arts degree in economics, women and gender studies from the University of California, Davis, in 2010. She later went on to attend Loyola Marymount University Law School, where she received her Juris Doctor in 2015.

During her legal studies, Ms. Ghuman worked as a law clerk at a prominent law firm, which gave her an early experience in the law field. She also served as a judicial extern at the United States Bankruptcy Court for the Central District of California, and later served under Judge Craig Richman in the Superior Court of Los Angeles County.

Within a short span of time, Ms. Ghuman has made mammoth strides in the legal field. She is a certified mediator pursuant to the California Dispute Resolution Programs Act. Before establishing her firm, she served as a civil rights fellow and also served as a volunteer mediator at the California Department of Fair Employment and Housing.

Beyond her courtroom achievements, Ms. Ghuman is a member of the president's advisory committee on women in the legal profession at the Los Angeles County Bar Association. She is also a member of the Barristers Committee, DFEH Committee and Workers Outreach Committee at the California Employment Lawyers Association.
